summary: Phase 2 Fleet Features Testing Complete - Backend APIs and Frontend UI fully functional with new fields (gallery, tour_scenes, specs, highlights, year, color, price_from). All features tested: Fleet list/detail pages, Lightbox gallery, 360° PhotoSphereTour, specifications grid, trip estimator with prefilled vehicle type, and CTA buttons. Phase 1 regression tests passed.

design_issues.issue: Close button can be blocked by exit-intent modal overlay in some cases
design_issues.workaround: Escape key works to close lightbox

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/public/fleet returns list with all new fields (gallery, tour_scenes, specs, highlights, year, color, price_from, capacity, features)
Backend: GET /api/public/fleet/{id} returns detail with properly structured gallery (url, caption), tour_scenes (id, label, panorama), specs (key, label, value)
Backend: POST /api/public/trip-estimate calculates correctly (Rp 4,440,000 for 2 days, 300km)
Fleet page: Cards display with capacity badges '14 kursi', '360° Kabin' badges, and 'mulai Rp X' pricing
Fleet page: Loading state (fleet-loading) and empty state (fleet-empty) have correct data-testids
FleetDetail: H1 title displays vehicle name correctly
FleetDetail: Gallery section renders 4 thumbnails with data-testid='fleet-gallery-{index}'
FleetDetail: Lightbox opens on thumbnail click with counter '1 / 4'
FleetDetail: Lightbox next/prev buttons work and counter updates correctly
FleetDetail: PhotoSphereTour container renders with data-testid='photo-sphere-tour'
FleetDetail: 3 tour scene tabs (depan, tengah, belakang) render with correct data-testids
FleetDetail: Clicking tour scene tabs does NOT cause runtime errors or crashes
FleetDetail: Specifications grid displays with icons (capacity, transmission, fuel, entertainment)
FleetDetail: Trip estimator widget found with data-testid='fleet-estimator'
FleetDetail: Vehicle type prefilled correctly (Hiace Premio 14)
FleetDetail: Estimator calculates total on submit (Rp 4,440,000 for Bali destination)
FleetDetail: 'Minta Penawaran' button links to /quotation
FleetDetail: 'Chat WhatsApp' button has wa.me link
Regression: Home page loads with hero and hero-trip-estimator
Regression: Hero trip estimator calculates correctly (Rp 4,440,000 for Bromo)
Regression: Theme toggle (nav-theme-switch) works and toggles html.dark class

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all features working, 1 minor UI issue with lightbox close button)
